extraction_metadata.notes: Extraction from PMC article. Pimecrolimus is an FDA-approved calcineurin inhibitor (topical dermatology) repurposed here for neuronal apoptosis modulation. Docking against apoptotic proteins is the in-silico component.

title: Effect of Pimecrolimus on apoptotic pathways in H2O2-treated SH-SY5Y cells: molecular docking + in vitro validation
subtitle_or_tagline: An FDA-approved calcineurin inhibitor repurposed against the apoptotic cascade — docking-guided hypothesis confirmed in neuronal culture.
topic: Pimecrolimus (an FDA-approved calcineurin inhibitor used in dermatology) is docked against apoptotic-pathway proteins and then validated in vitro on differentiated SH-SY5Y neurons under H2O2 insult, showing reduced apoptosis and modulated Caspase-3 / calcineurin signaling.

components.name: Molecular docking
components.role: Pimecrolimus docked against apoptotic-pathway proteins (calcineurin, Caspase-3, related effectors) to predict binding pose.

components.name: SH-SY5Y cellular model
components.role: Differentiated dopaminergic-like neurons under H2O2 oxidative insult ± Pimecrolimus.

components.name: Apoptosis panel
components.role: MTT, Annexin-V/PI flow cytometry, Caspase-3 activity assay, calcineurin activity assay.

architecture.data_flow: Pimecrolimus structure → Docking vs apoptotic targets → predicted mechanism → SH-SY5Y + H2O2 ± Pimecrolimus → viability / apoptosis / Caspase-3 / calcineurin readouts.

workflow_steps: Step 1 - Dock Pimecrolimus against apoptotic-pathway proteins.
Step 4 - Read out viability (MTT), apoptosis (Annexin-V/PI), Caspase-3 activity.
Step 5 - Quantify calcineurin activity to confirm on-target mechanism.
Step 6 - Connect docking pose → cellular effect → mechanistic pathway.
key_claims: Pimecrolimus docks favorably into apoptotic-pathway protein active sites.
Pre-treatment rescued SH-SY5Y viability under H2O2 insult.
Annexin-V positive population was reduced by Pimecrolimus treatment.
Caspase-3 activity was attenuated — consistent with downstream apoptosis suppression.
Calcineurin activity modulation confirms the on-target repurposing hypothesis.
Repurposing an FDA-approved drug de-risks the translational path relative to novel scaffolds.
caveats_or_warnings: Pimecrolimus is a topical dermatology drug — systemic exposure is currently limited; CNS repurposing requires BBB formulation work.
Calcineurin inhibitors carry immunosuppressive risk; chronic CNS use requires careful safety profiling.
Effect sizes are approximate; full-text verification required.
Docking against apoptotic-pathway proteins does not establish direct Caspase-3 active-site binding — mechanism may be upstream.

molecule_metadata.name: Pimecrolimus
molecule_metadata.notable: Large macrolactam (MW 810) — will be flagged as BBB-impermeable by rule-based predictors. Formulation (e.g., nanoparticle, intranasal) required for CNS use.
molecule_metadata.tradition: FDA-approved for atopic dermatitis since 2001; well-characterized safety profile.
